title: VectorScript document
description: A JSON vector graphics document. See README.md.

parameters.description: Parameter defaults: numbers, "#" colors, or expressions. A color parameter is a paint. Names share the defs namespace.

animation.description: Makes the document animated. Expressions read $TIME (seconds) and $DURATION.

loop.description: play again from the start; default true

viewBox.description: [x, y, width, height] of user space mapped onto size

preserveAspectRatio.description: How the viewBox fits size when their aspect ratios differ, as SVG's preserveAspectRatio. Default none: each axis scales on its own.

pattern.description: A tile of elements, clipped to [0, 0, width, height] and repeated in the painted element's user space.

oneOf.description: SVG transform syntax, e.g. translate(10 20) rotate(45).

path.description: SVG path data (M L H V C S Q T A Z).

font.description: System font PostScript, family or full name. Default Helvetica.

letterSpacing.description: Extra points between characters; negative tightens. Default 0.

fontFile.description: A font file (TTF, OTF, TTC): a path relative to the document, an absolute path, or a file: URL. When set, font only picks a face in the file.

lineHeight.description: Distance between baselines as a multiple of fontSize. Default 1.2.

text.description: The text; \n starts a new line.

letterSpacing.description: Extra points between characters; negative tightens. Default 0.

lineHeight.description: Distance between baselines as a multiple of fontSize. Default 1.2.

width.description: Wrap lines at word breaks to fit this many points.

onPath.description: SVG path data the text runs along, one line, instead of at. Glyphs past either end are left out.

offset.description: Distance along onPath that anchor places the text against. Default 0.

image.description: PNG, JPEG or other ImageIO image: a path relative to the document, an absolute path, a file: URL, or a data:<type>;base64,<data> URI.

size.description: [width, height]; default the image's pixel size

mask.description: Elements whose brightness (luminance) or opacity (alpha) sets how much of the element shows. In the element's own coordinates, like clip.

blendMode.description: How the element combines with what is behind it (CSS mix-blend-mode).

marker.description: Drawn at path, line, polyline and polygon vertices, origin on the vertex, in user units. none cancels an inherited marker.

anyOf.description: none, or the name of an element in defs

orient.description: auto (along the path, the default), auto-start-reverse, or degrees
auto (along the path, the default), auto-start-reverse, or degrees

filter.description: A CSS filter function. Lengths are user units.

filterList.description: Filters applied in order, before clip, mask, opacity and blend mode.

expression.description: An expression in place of a number, such as "$W / 2". Reads $NAME parameters; supports + - * / %, comparisons, && || !, and functions such as min, max, sqrt, sin, if.
